name: Fairfield County, CT
findings: Fairfield County has 4,522 nonprofit organizations. 1,734 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,418 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Fairfield County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few political organizations list public events
observations.text: 8 political organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 18 would.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through political groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 686 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
